During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''patient''' was being treated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Carosi XII]] by the [[Carosite]] [[Medic/Legends|medic]], [[Tamo Lan]]. During their stay, the patient was threatened by a [[Unidentified Twi'lek (Carosi XII)|enslaver]]. Tamo Lan was forced to killed the [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] to protect the patient.<ref name="Cracken's Rebel Operatives article">{{JournalCite|10|Cracken's Rebel Operatives (article)}}</ref>
